claims.text: Gating each retrieved passage by its relevance to the question before reading stops irrelevant passages from diluting the reader's evidence.
Gated retrieval adapters improve exact match over FiD-base by 2.1 points on Natural Questions and 3.4 points on HotpotQA.
On TriviaQA, the 0.3 EM gain of gated retrieval adapters over FiD-base is within the standard deviation over three seeds.
A single gate shared across tasks might remove the need to train one gate per benchmark.
